name: Blanc Royal
description: Extrait de Parfum, 50 ml. Creamy white rose and orchid resting on warm Bourbon vanilla and golden resin. Soft, luminous and quietly regal.

name: Rêve Paradoxé
description: Extrait de Parfum, 50 ml. Sparkling red grapefruit meets velvety rose and a thread of saffron. Fresh and dark at once, a dream that contradicts itself.

name: Noir Prestige
description: Extrait de Parfum, 50 ml. Smoked sandalwood, black pepper and dark vanilla over glowing amber. Deep, confident and made for the evening.

name: Rouge Absolu
description: Extrait de Parfum, 50 ml. Crimson rose and ripe raspberry wrapped in precious woods and amber. Bold, velvety and unapologetically passionate.

name: Bleu Éternel
description: Extrait de Parfum, 50 ml. Lavender and white jasmine with a hint of dark berries, settling into smooth wood and amber. Calm, deep and timeless.
